 HONOR Philippines is offering a smartphone for just P1,111 this 11.11
 Score a brand-new HONOR smartphone for just P1,111 this 11.11! 🎁 HONOR Philippines is dropping major holiday discounts of up to P30,000 across Lazada, Shopee, and TikTok Shop. Here's everything you need to know 👇 #HONORPhilippines #TechDeals
 by 
 ASTIG PR 
 15 hours ago 15 hours ago 
 Advertisements 
 MANILA, Philippines (Nov 2026): Pinoy bargain hunters looking to jumpstart their holiday shopping can score an HONOR Play 10 smartphone for only PHP 1,111 (approx. $19) as HONOR Philippines kicks off its early Christmas sale.
 The promotion runs from Nov. 3 to 13, 2026, across Lazada, Shopee, and TikTok Shop. Along with the budget device deal, shoppers can find price drops of up to PHP 30,000 (approx. $515) on select devices, bundled freebies, and zero-interest installment plans.
 Exclusive platform steals
 On Lazada, the HONOR Play 10 drops to PHP 1,111 (approx. $19) during a limited midnight sale starting at 12:00 a.m. on Nov. 11, available while supplies last. Buyers eyeing the flagship HONOR Magic V6 can also get up to 24 months of 0% interest installment through participating credit cards.
 Over on Shopee, shoppers can join the "Watch the CEO's New Jowa and Win an HONOR 600S" campaign for a chance to take home a unit. Shopee will also exclusively offer the arrival of the HONOR Play 20A.
 Meanwhile, TikTok Shop provides early access to the HONOR Pad X7b with discounts of up to PHP 2,000 (approx. $34). Freebies are also bundled with select purchases, including the HONOR 600S and HONOR Pad X9b Max.
 Flexible payment options
 To make holiday shopping more manageable, buyers can take advantage of flexible payment arrangements through bank credit cards and Buy Now, Pay Later services like SPayLater, LazPayLater, and TikTok PayLater. Eligible transactions qualify for up to 24 months of 0% interest installment on major credit cards, or up to six months of 0% interest on participating PayLater options.
 The nationwide sale includes a wide selection of devices across official HONOR stores, covering the HONOR Play 10, HONOR Play 20A, HONOR Pad X7b, HONOR Pad X9b Max, HONOR 600S, HONOR Magic V6, HONOR Choice Earbuds Clip, HONOR Watch 6, and HONOR Choice Pencil.
